title: ResearchPlan
description: Output of DR-001's Research Planner: a fixed set of 3-5 subtasks covering a query, each with its own coverage topic and budget, produced before any Researcher (DR-002) starts. The 3-5 bound is enforced structurally (minItems/maxItems), not by application code, so a plan that doesn't fit can never reach a Researcher.

coverage_topic.description: The distinct facet of the query this subtask covers — DR-003's Sufficiency Gate checks these against a coverage matrix to decide whether the plan as a whole was sufficient.
